#### 3. Wix (Wix Stores / Wix eCommerce)

##### 3.1 Auth
- "third-party apps integrating with Wix APIs must authenticate using the OAuth protocol"; "API keys… aren't available for use in third-party Wix apps." https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authentication/about-authentication.md
- **OAuth = client credentials per app instance:** `POST https://www.wixapis.com/oauth2/token` `{grant_type:"client_credentials", client_id:<APP_ID>, client_secret:<APP_SECRET>, instance_id}`; "The token is valid for 4 hours"; header `Authorization: <ACCESS_TOKEN>`. App ID/secret from the app dashboard OAuth page; `instanceId` from the App Instance Installed webhook, any webhook payload, service-plugin metadata or the app-instance query param. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authentication/authenticate-using-oauth.md — "Custom authentication" (authorization-code + refresh tokens, `https://www.wixapis.com/oauth/access`) is "no longer available for new apps". https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authentication/about-oauth.md
- **Install = the consent step:** standard install flow (App Market / dashboard / editor / shared link) — "Wix prompts the Wix user to select the intended site and grant permissions"; external install flow lets you start from your own site and get redirected back. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/install-your-app/about-app-installation.md — installation URL `https://www.wix.com/app-installer?appId=…&postInstallationUrl=…&shareUrlId=…` (shareUrlId required for unlisted apps); redirect returns `appId`, `tenantId`, `instanceId`, `signedInstance` ("Verify signedInstance before you trust instanceId"). https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/install-your-app/about-the-external-install-flow.md
- **Unlisted apps need no review:** "the app is considered unlisted, and there's no need to go through the submission process"; create a Share Install Link from the app dashboard. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/install-your-app/share-an-app-install-link.md — App Market review is "an automated AI process… from submission to published in minutes". https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/about-app-distribution.md
- App Instance Installed webhook payload: `appId`, `originInstanceId`; metadata `instanceId`, `accountInfo.siteId`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/app-management/app-instance/app-instance-installed.md
- **API keys (own-account path):** "Only account owners and co-owners can create API keys" at https://manage.wix.com/account/api-keys; key scoped to all sites or specific sites; site ID via Query Sites or the dashboard URL after `/dashboard/`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/api-keys/about-api-keys.md — headers `Authorization: <API_KEY>` plus exactly one of `wix-site-id` / `wix-account-id`; example test call `POST https://www.wixapis.com/stores/v3/products/query`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/api-keys/make-api-calls-with-an-api-key.md — key string format/prefix: unverified.
- **Verdict:** true OAuth "Connect → sign in → Allow" = YES for any third party (unlisted app + share install link / app-installer URL, no review). Key-paste fallback = API key + site ID.

##### 3.2 Multi-store model
- One Wix site hosts one Wix Stores instance; an account holds many sites/projects — Sites APIs (Projects, Sites/Query Sites, Site Actions, Site Folders). https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/account-level/sites/introduction.md
- Multi-location inventory (Catalog V3): "Each inventory item is uniquely identified by its variantId and locationId"; default location auto-created; Stores Locations V3 read-only; create locations via Locations API with `"INVENTORY"` in `locationTypes`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-inventory-management.md — Locations API. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/locations/introduction.md
- Multilingual API exists. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/multilingual.md

##### 3.3 API surface
- **Stores Catalog V3:** Products V3 (CRUD, Query/Search/Count, Bulk Create/Update/Delete, Create/Update Product With Inventory, events Product Created/Updated/Deleted), Inventory Items V3 (CRUD, bulk create/update/delete, bulk increment/decrement incl. by variant+location, events), Stores Locations V3, Brands V3, Ribbons V3, Info Sections V3, Customizations V3 (options/modifiers), Read-Only Variants V3 ("up to 1,000 variants per request"), Categories (tree, bulk add/remove items), Promotions V3. Menu: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores.md ; overview https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/introduction.md ; pricing fields `actualPrice`, `compareAtPrice`, `cost`, `handle` for re-import. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/products-v3/introduction.md
- **Catalog V1:** Catalog (Create/Update/Query Products, collections, media, variants, bulk property updates) + Inventory ("up to 300 variants… in a single call"). https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v1/inventory/introduction.md
- **eCommerce platform:** Cart, Checkout, Abandoned Checkout, Discount Rules, Recommendations, Orders, Order Transactions, Order Fulfillments; service plugins for additional fees, shipping rates, validations, payments, catalog. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/introduction.md — Orders section: Orders, Draft Orders, Order Billing, Order Transactions, Order Payment Requests, Order Invoices, Order Fulfillments, Orders Settings. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/introduction.md — Orders API: get/search/update/cancel/archive/create (`channelInfo.type`, `OTHER_PLATFORM`); events approved/updated/canceled. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/orders/introduction.md — Fulfillments: up to 300 line items per fulfillment, bulk ≤100 orders, statuses Pending/Accepted/Ready/In_Delivery/Fulfilled. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-fulfillments/introduction.md
- CRM: Contacts (+ V5), Labels, Extended Fields, Members, Loyalty (incl. Coupons under Rewards), Marketing consent. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/crm.md — Business Management: Analytics, Locations, Marketing, Multilingual, Payments, Site Properties, etc. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management.md
- Not located in the fetched menus: stand-alone Coupons API, Media Manager, Tax, Shipping-rate reads, Returns — unverified.

##### 3.4 Webhooks
- Configured per app in the app dashboard; payload is a signed JWT — verify with the app public key from the Webhooks page; every event carries `instanceId`, `eventType`; must return 200 within 1250 ms; up to 12 retries (1 min, 10 min, 1 h, 2 h ×3, 4 h ×3, 8 h ×2, 12 h); at-least-once, possibly out of order; Logs tab; webhooks are versioned with the app. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/api-integrations/events-and-webhooks/about-webhooks.md
- Each catalog version has its own events; subscribe to both V1 and V3. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-versioning/introduction.md
- GraphQL: "Developer Preview"; `POST https://www.wixapis.com/graphql`, `Authorization: <API_KEY or Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>>`, "query and mutate Wix data". https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/work-with-wix-apis/platform/about-the-wix-graph-ql-api.md

##### 3.5 Rate limits / bulk
- 429: "wait a minute and then retry"; 409 revision conflicts on updates. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/work-with-wix-apis/troubleshooting/troubleshooting.md — numeric quotas: unverified.
- Bulk Create Products: `POST https://www.wixapis.com/stores/v3/bulk/products/create`, "up to 100 products", ≤1000 variants. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/products-v3/bulk-create-products.md — other bulk sizes in 3.3.

##### 3.6 Sandbox
- Free development site from the app dashboard ("Test App → Test on dev site"; templates incl. Stores V3 and Stores V1; "Premium & Wix Payments capabilities"); share test link. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/test-your-app/test-your-app-on-a-premium-site.md

##### 3.7 Versioning
- Versions per module (v1/v2/v3 in path); "Wix doesn't remove or 'sunset' deprecated APIs"; changelog https://dev.wix.com/changelog. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/work-with-wix-apis/platform/about-api-versions-and-deprecation.md
- Catalog V3 "rolled out to new users only" initially; "Each site supports either Catalog V1 or Catalog V3"; apps must confirm V3 compatibility. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/introduction.md — Get Catalog Version once per site. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-versioning/introduction.md
- SDK `@wix/sdk`, `@wix/stores` (`productsV3`), `ApiKeyStrategy` / `AppStrategy`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/api-keys/make-api-calls-with-an-api-key.md

#### 4. Squarespace (Commerce APIs)

##### 4.1 Auth
- API key: "Settings… Advanced… Developer API Keys… GENERATE KEY"; "this is the only time the API key is visible"; keys never expire while the site is active; "Available only with Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan"; per-API read/read-write permissions; Webhook Subscriptions API "Read-write (OAuth only)". https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/authentication-and-permissions
- Headers `Authorization: Bearer <key or OAuth token>`, mandatory `User-Agent` ("Requests without a User-Agent header are rejected"), HTTPS only; base `https://api.squarespace.com/{api-version}/{resource-path}`. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/making-requests
- **OAuth:** authorize `https://login.squarespace.com/api/1/login/oauth/provider/authorize` (`client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `scope`, `state`, optional `website_id`, `access_type=offline`); token `POST https://login.squarespace.com/api/1/login/oauth/provider/tokens` with Basic `client_id:client_secret`; access token 30 min, refresh token 7 days, one-time-use refresh; scopes `website.orders[.read]`, `website.transactions.read`, `website.inventory[.read]`, `website.products[.read]`, `website.contacts[.read]`, `website.discounts[.read]`. Client registration at https://account.squarespace.com/developer-apps: "We will review your registration and respond with your_client_id and your_client_secret as soon as possible"; initiate URL "Applies only to Squarespace partner apps". https://developers.squarespace.com/oauth
- **Verdict:** true OAuth = YES but gated by a Squarespace review of the client registration (not instant self-serve); until approved, the merchant path is key-paste: Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys → paste key; test with `GET https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/inventory` (≤50 items) https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/adjust-stock-quantities or `GET https://api.squarespace.com/v2/commerce/products` (path as rendered on https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/retrieve-all-products; the versioning page labels Products "v2").

##### 4.2 Multi-store model
- One site = one store; one key per site; no multi-storefront concept documented (absent/unverified).

##### 4.3 API surface
- Families: Analytics, Contacts, Discounts, Inventory, Orders, Products, Profiles, Transactions, Webhook Subscriptions. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/overview
- Products (v2): create/update Physical, Service, Gift Card; Download products update-only; variants, up to 100 images, image upload/reorder endpoints, store pages. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/products-overview — list: cursor, `type`, `modifiedAfter/Before`, `query`, 50 per page; `pricing.basePrice/salePrice/onSale`, `tags`. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/retrieve-all-products
- Inventory: `POST /1.0/commerce/inventory/adjustments` (`incrementOperations`, `decrementOperations`, `setFiniteOperations`, `setUnlimitedOperations`; `Idempotency-Key` required; 204). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/adjust-stock-quantities
- Orders: list (`paymentStates`), get, create, fulfil `POST /1.0/commerce/orders/{id}/fulfillments` (`shipments[carrierName, service, shipDate, trackingNumber, trackingUrl]`, `shouldSendNotification`). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/orders-overview and https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/fulfill-order
- Transactions (1.0, read: totals, payments, refunds). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/transactions-overview — Profiles (1.0, read-only, "maintenance mode"). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/profiles-overview — Contacts (v1, CRUD + address book + 6 webhooks; API-key auth added 2026-06-17). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/contacts-overview and https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/changelog — Discounts (v1, CRUDL; promo code or automatic; fixed, percentage, BXGY, free shipping). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/discounts-overview — Analytics (1.0, transaction summaries, ≤1,000 contact IDs). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/analytics-overview
- Absent from the family list: categories/collections API, CMS content, tax config, shipping rates, payments, returns, media beyond product images.

##### 4.4 Webhooks
- Topics: `extension.uninstall`, `order.create`, `order.update`, `contact.create/update/delete`, `address.create/update/delete` — no product/inventory topics. https://developers.squarespace.com/webhooks/overview
- `Squarespace-Signature` = HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the raw UTF-8 body using the hex-decoded subscription secret; constant-time compare. https://developers.squarespace.com/webhooks/verifying-notifications
- Delivery: 2xx = success; retried "several times for up to 48 hours"; "may delete a webhook subscription if multiple requests are unsuccessful"; at-least-once, unordered. https://developers.squarespace.com/webhooks/notification-delivery
- Subscriptions: `POST/GET /1.0/webhook_subscriptions`, `GET/POST/DELETE /1.0/webhook_subscriptions/{id}`, `POST …/actions/rotateSecret`, `POST …/actions/sendTestNotification`; HTTPS endpoint; "API keys are not supported" (OAuth only); listing shows up to 25. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/create-webhook-subscription
- GraphQL: none documented (absent).

##### 4.5 Rate limits / bulk
- "300 requests per minute"; 429 with "a cool down period of one minute"; Create Order limited to 100/hour/website when using an API key (not OAuth). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/rate-limits
- Bulk: inventory adjustments batch (limit per request unverified); no bulk product endpoints documented.

##### 4.6 Sandbox
- None documented; APIs require a Commerce Advanced site (4.1). Trial-site API access: unverified.

##### 4.7 Versioning
- Per-resource path versions: products v2 (legacy 1.1, 1.0), contacts v1, discounts v1, inventory/orders/profiles/transactions/webhook_subscriptions 1.0; additive changes are non-breaking; "significant advance notice before deprecating any version"; changelog. https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/versioning and https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/changelog

#### 5. PrestaShop (Webservice 1.7/8.x/9 + Admin API 9)

##### 5.1 Auth
- **Webservice:** enable at Advanced Parameters > Web service ("Enable PrestaShop Webservice" = Yes), "Add new webservice key" → key "32 characters long" (Generate button), per-resource GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD checkboxes, shop association in multistore. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/creating-access/ — HTTP Basic with the key as username and no password: `Authorization: Basic base64(KEY + ':')`; URL-embedded key "very risky"; `GET /api/` returns the resources the key may access; may need `CGIPassAuth`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/testing-access/ — JSON output via `output_format=JSON`/`Io-Format: JSON`; "As of PrestaShop 8.1, the Webservice is only able to output JSON, it cannot read JSON inputs." https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/getting-started/
- **Admin API (9.x):** built on API Platform 3, "OAuth authorization protocol and CQRS commands". https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/ — enabled by default; Advanced Parameters > Admin API: Client name, Client ID, Description, Lifetime (seconds), Enabled, Scopes; secret "you won't be able to see it again"; "Force security in debug mode"; production requires HTTPS. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/authorization_server/internal_authorization/ and https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/how-to-use/ — token `POST /admin-api/access_token` (form: `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id`, `client_secret`, `scope[]`) → `{token_type:"Bearer", expires_in:3600, access_token:<JWT>}`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/authorization_server/internal_authorization/ — external authorization server supported; "The website will always be the Resource Server." https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/oauth/
- History: 8.1 milestone added the authorization server / client-credentials grant (APIS04, APIS05, APIS07, APIS08). https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2023/prestashop-8-1-beta-release/ — in 9.0 "still a work in progress… additional endpoints… planned". https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2025/prestashop-9-0-available/
- **Verdict:** true OAuth redirect flow = NO (client-credentials only). Key-paste: Webservice key (Advanced Parameters > Web service) tested with `GET /api/?output_format=JSON`, or Admin API client (Advanced Parameters > Admin API) tested with `GET /admin-api/api-client/infos`.

##### 5.2 Multi-store model
- Webservice: `id_shop=` / `id_group_shop=` on requests; key must be associated with each shop; `PS_MULTISHOP_FEATURE_ACTIVE`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/advanced-use/manage-multishop/ and https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/cheat-sheet/
- Admin API: experimental flag `admin_api_multistore` (Advanced Parameters > New & Experimental Features); every request needs exactly one of `shopId`, `shopIds`, `shopGroupId`, `allShops`, else 400; `shopIds` in payloads = association. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/multi-shop/

##### 5.3 API surface
- Webservice resources (69): addresses, attachments, carriers, cart_rules, carts, categories, combinations, configurations, contacts, content_management_system, countries, currencies, customer_messages, customer_threads, customers, customizations, deliveries, employees, groups, guests, image_types, images, languages, manufacturers, messages, order_carriers, order_cart_rules, order_details, order_histories, order_invoices, order_payments, order_slip, order_states, orders, price_ranges, product_customization_fields, product_feature_values, product_features, product_option_values, product_options, product_suppliers, products, search, shop_groups, shop_urls, shops, specific_price_rules, specific_prices, states, stock_availables, stock_movement_reasons, stock_movements, stocks, stores, suppliers, supply_order_* (5), tags, tax_rule_groups, tax_rules, taxes, translated_configurations, warehouse_product_locations, warehouses, weight_ranges, zones. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/resources/
- Images: `/api/images/{products|categories|manufacturers|suppliers|stores|customizations|general}`; `POST` multipart field `image`; update via `PUT` or `ps_method=PUT`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/advanced-use/image-management/
- List params: `display`, `filter[field]=…` (OR `[a|b]`, range `[min,max]`, `%` wildcards), `sort`, `limit=offset,count`, `date=1`, `language`, `ps_method`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/advanced-use/additional-list-parameters/ and https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/cheat-sheet/
- Admin API 9: `GET /admin-api/api-client/info`, `GET/PUT/POST/DELETE /admin-api/customers/group[/{id}]`; scopes incl. `api_client_read/write`, `product_read/write`, `cart_rule_write`, `customer_group_read/write`, `hook_read/write`, `module_read/write`; OpenAPI at `/admin-api/docs.json`, UI at `/admin-api/docs.html`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/how-to-use/ — resources auto-loaded from core and modules ("only usable when the module is installed and enabled"). https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/resource_server/api-resources/ — core `src/PrestaShopBundle/ApiPlatform/Resources` on `develop` holds only `ApiClient.php`, `Language.php` (README: "contain only ApiPlatform resources that need to stay in the core"). https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/tree/develop/src/PrestaShopBundle/ApiPlatform/Resources
- Absent: payment processing, reports, returns as a first-class resource (credit slips via `order_slip`).

##### 5.4 Webhooks
- No native outbound webhooks: hooks are in-process PHP ("associate your code to some specific PrestaShop events"; `hookActionX(array $params)`); the concept page has no webhook/HTTP notion. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/modules/concepts/hooks/
- `ps_eventbus` "is a module companion for CloudSync" (products, stock, employees, currencies, languages, stores), requires PS Accounts; third-party consumption not documented. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrestaShopCorp/ps_eventbus/master/README.md
- GraphQL: none (absent).

##### 5.5 Rate limits / bulk
- No rate limiting documented (unverified/absent). Pagination via `limit`. Bulk endpoints: none documented for the Webservice; Admin API bulk: unverified.

##### 5.6 Sandbox
- Docker `prestashop/prestashop:<version>[-php][-apache|-fpm]`; `PS_INSTALL_AUTO=1`, `PS_DEMO_MODE`, `PS_DOMAIN`, DB vars. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/basics/installation/environments/docker/

##### 5.7 Versioning
- Webservice at unversioned `/api/`; Admin API at unversioned `/admin-api/` (5.1/5.3). `PSWS-Version` response header: unverified.
- Release cycle: majors "every 12–18 months"; minors "6-9 months following the previous major"; patches "About every 6 weeks". https://www.prestashop-project.org/project-organization/release-cycle/ — 9.0.0 released 2025-06-10 (PHP 8.1–8.4, Symfony 6.4 LTS). https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2025/prestashop-9-0-available/ — 8.2.x in extended support until 10.0.0. https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2025/82x-extended-support-phase/ — 9.1.3 maintenance release exists (2026). https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2026/prestashop-9-1-3-maintenance-release/
- Legacy Webservice "is expected to disappear from PrestaShop in the next few years". https://build.prestashop-project.org/news/2024/meet-prestashop9-api/

#### 6. Shopware 6

##### 6.1 Auth
- **Integration (client credentials):** Settings > System > Integrations → name, "permissions of the administrator" toggle or a role; "access ID and a security key" shown once, regenerable. https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/settings/system/integrationen — `POST /api/oauth/token` `{grant_type:"client_credentials", client_id:<access key ID>, client_secret:<secret>}` → `{token_type:"Bearer", expires_in:3600, access_token}`; `Authorization: Bearer`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/integrations-api/admin-api/authentication.html — the newer page shows `expires_in` 600 for the password grant and says "For integrations… prefer client_credentials". https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/auth-api-requests.html (actual TTL: read from the token response; access-key prefix format unverified)
- Password grant: `client_id=administration`, `grant_type=password`, username/password → access + refresh token; local shortcut only. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/auth-api-requests.html — 6.7: scopes as space-delimited `scope`; `/api/oauth/authorize` removed. https://developer.shopware.com/release-notes/6.7/6.7.0.0.html
- **App System handshake:** manifest `<setup><registrationUrl>`/`<secret>`; Shopware `GET`s the registration URL with `shop-id`, `shop-url`, `timestamp` and `shopware-app-signature` (signature of the query string with the app secret; `sw-version` since 6.4.1.0); app answers `proof` ("SHA-256 HMAC of the concatenation of shopId, shopUrl, and your app's name"), `secret` (64–255 chars), `confirmation_url`; Shopware POSTs `apiKey`, `secretKey`, `timestamp`, `shopUrl`, `shopId` signed with `shopware-shop-signature`; use `apiKey`/`secretKey` "as client_id and client_secret" for client credentials; 5 s timeout. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/lifecycle/app-registration-setup.html — signing summary. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/lifecycle/app-signature-verification.html — manifest `<permissions>` (`read/create/update/delete`, `<crud>` since 6.7.3.0), `<webhooks>`, `<allowed-hosts>`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/app-reference/manifest-reference.html
- Where the merchant clicks: self-hosted upload zip in Extensions > My Extensions ("only for users of a self-hosted shop… not relevant for… SaaS"). https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/extensions/myextensions — CLI `bin/console app:install --activate MyExampleApp`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/app-base-guide.html — SaaS: install from the Store. https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/saas/extensions
- Store API (customer-facing): `sw-access-key` from a sales channel ("generate an API Access ID for this sales channel"). https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/settings/saleschannel and https://developer.shopware.com/docs/concepts/api/store-api.html
- **Verdict:** redirect-style OAuth = NO. The merchant "Allow" moment is the app install (consents to manifest permissions); on SaaS that means a Store-listed app. Least-friction key-paste: Settings > System > Integrations → paste access key ID + secret; test with `POST /api/search/sales-channel` `{"limit":1}` (search endpoint per https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/search-criteria.html).

##### 6.2 Multi-store model
- Sales channels "define how your catalog is exposed" (Storefront, Headless Store API, Product feed, Custom); each controls language, currency, country, tax mode, customer group, payment/shipping defaults, domains; "Products must have a product_visibility row for each sales channel". https://developer.shopware.com/docs/concepts/commerce/catalog/sales-channels.html and https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/settings/saleschannel
- Headers `sw-language-id`, `sw-version-id`, `sw-inheritance`, `sw-currency-id`, `sw-skip-trigger-flow`, `sw-app-integration-id`, `indexing-behavior`, `indexing-skip`, `indexing-only`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/request-headers.html and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/PlatformRequest.php
- Multi-Inventory (Shopware Commercial, Beyond plan): `warehouse`, `warehouse_group`, `product_warehouse`; via `/api/warehouse`, `/api/_action/sync`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/plugins/api/multi-inventory.html

##### 6.3 API surface
- "CRUD operations for every entity"; reference at Stoplight. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/concepts/api/admin-api.html — `POST /api/search/{entity}`, `POST /api/search-ids/{entity}` with Criteria (`limit`, `page`, `filter`, `post-filter`, `sort`, `associations`, `includes`, `aggregations`, `ids`, `term`, `query`, `grouping`, `total-count-mode` 0/1/2). https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/search-criteria.html — example flow `POST /api/category`, `POST /api/product` (price in system default currency, `visibilities[{salesChannelId, visibility}]`). https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/flows/create-product.html
- Sync API `POST /api/_action/sync` (operations `key`, `entity`, `action` upsert|delete, `payload`); headers `indexing-behavior`, `indexing-skip`, `indexing-only`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Api/Controller/SyncController.php — behavior values `use-queue-indexing`, `disable-indexing`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/DataAbstractionLayer/Indexing/EntityIndexerRegistry.php (`fail-on-error` / `single-operation` headers are not in trunk PlatformRequest — unverified for current versions)
- Media `POST /api/_action/media/{mediaId}/upload?fileName=`, `…/rename`, `GET /api/_action/media/provide-name`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Content/Media/Api/MediaUploadController.php
- State machine `GET /api/_action/state-machine/{entityName}/{entityId}/state`, `POST …/state/{transition}`; order shortcuts `POST /api/_action/order/{orderId}/state/{transition}`, `/api/_action/order_transaction/{id}/state/{transition}`, `/api/_action/order_delivery/{id}/state/{transition}`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/System/StateMachine/Api/StateMachineActionController.php and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Checkout/Order/Api/OrderActionController.php
- Documents: download/preview routes (`/api/_action/document/{id}/{deepLinkCode}`, `/api/_action/order/document/download`, preview) — create route not in trunk DocumentController: unverified. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Checkout/Document/Controller/DocumentController.php
- Promotion codes `/api/_action/promotion/codes/{generate-fixed|generate-individual|replace-individual|add-individual|preview}`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Checkout/Promotion/Api/PromotionController.php
- Import/Export `/api/_action/import-export/{features|prepare|process|cancel|file/prepare-download/{fileId}|file/download|prepare-template-file-download|mapping-from-template}`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Content/ImportExport/Controller/ImportExportActionController.php
- OpenAPI `/api/_info/openapi3.json` (Bearer), entity schema `/api/_info/open-api-schema.json`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/development/integrations-api/auth-api-requests.html
- Returns (Commercial "Return Management") and reports: unverified/absent.

##### 6.4 Webhooks
- Manifest `<webhook name="…" url="…" event="product.written" onlyLiveVersion="true"/>` (6.5.7.0+); payload `source{url, shopId, appVersion, eventId}`, `data{event, payload}` (written/deleted events carry only `primaryKey`), `timestamp`; header `shopware-shop-signature` = "SHA256 HMAC of the request body… signed with the secret your app assigned the shop"; also `sw-version`, `sw-context-language`, `sw-user-language`. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/webhook.html
- Events: `checkout.order.placed`, `checkout.customer.*`, `state_enter/state_leave.order|order_delivery|order_transaction.state.*`, `{entity}.written`/`{entity}.deleted` (product, product_price, category, sales_channel, customer, order, media, …), `app.installed/activated/deactivated/updated/deleted`, `shopware.updated`, newsletter/contact/review events. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/app-reference/webhook-events-reference.html
- Delivery (trunk source): async via Symfony Messenger (`#[AsMessageHandler] WebhookEventMessageHandler`), retries with `MAX_RETRIES`, headers `X-Shopware-Event-Id`, `X-Shopware-Sequence`, `X-Shopware-Attempt`; `webhook.error_count` increments and resets; `failure_strategy: disable_on_threshold` (experimental, v6.8) deactivates at `MAX_ERROR_COUNT`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Webhook/Handler/WebhookEventMessageHandler.php , https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Webhook/Service/WebhookDeliveryService.php , https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Webhook/Service/WebhookHealthService.php , https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Resources/config/packages/shopware.yaml (numeric retry/threshold values unverified)
- `webhook` entity (`name`, `eventName`, `url`, `onlyLiveVersion`, `errorCount`, `active`, `appId`). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Webhook/WebhookDefinition.php — Flow Builder "Call URL (Webhook)" action needs Shopware Commercial (Evolve). https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/features/webhook-actions-in-flow-builder
- GraphQL: none — only Admin API and Store API are documented. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/concepts/api/

##### 6.5 Rate limits / bulk
- Built-in limiters (since 6.4.6.0): `login`, `guest_login`, `oauth`, `notification` "10 / 10s, 15 / 30s, 20 / 60s"; `reset_password`, `user_recovery`, `contact_form`, `newsletter_form` "3 / 30s, 5 / 60s, 10 / 90s"; `cart_add_line_item` from `core.cart.lineItemAddLimit`; config `shopware.api.rate_limiter`; no post-auth Admin API throttle documented. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/hosting/infrastructure/rate-limiter.html — `api.max_limit: 500`, `store.max_limit: 100`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shopware/shopware/trunk/src/Core/Framework/Resources/config/packages/shopware.yaml
- Bulk: Sync API (6.3), Import/Export API; Multi-Inventory via sync.

##### 6.6 Sandbox
- Self-hosted Docker setup (Shopware CLI; dev-tools with demo data) or Dockware. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/installation/ and https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/guides/installation/community/dockware.html — SaaS trial: unverified.

##### 6.7 Versioning
- `/api/v{n}/…` removed in 6.4.0.0 (both forms from 6.3.5.0); "Deprecated fields and routes are currently tagged in a minor version and will be removed with the next major version", shown in OpenAPI + changelog. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/resources/references/adr/2020-12-02-removing-api-version.html
- Release policy: major "Once a year", minor "Every first Monday of the month", patch on demand; phases maintained → extended support → security-only → EOL; latest 6.7.13.1, 6.6 extended, 6.5 security. https://developer.shopware.com/release-notes/ — 6.6.0.0 2024-03-18 (PHP 8.2 min, Stock API default). https://developer.shopware.com/release-notes/6.6/6.6.0.0.html — 6.7.0.0 2025-06-17. https://developer.shopware.com/release-notes/6.7/6.7.0.0.html — 6.8 "planned for 2027 instead of 2026"; 6.6 extended support "until 6.8 becomes available". https://www.shopware.com/en/news/next-major-version-6-8-planned-for-2027/

---

#### Comparison table

| Platform | True OAuth "sign in + Allow" for a 3rd-party PIM? | Auth style (merchant path) | Multi-store model | Webhooks (signature) | GraphQL? | Sandbox |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BigCommerce | Yes technically (single-click app, auth-code grant) — but draft apps install only on stores owned by the developer's email; Unlisted needs partner approval; Public needs Marketplace review. https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/integrations/apps/guide/types | Key-paste fallback: store-level API account (`X-Auth-Token`, non-expiring). https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/start/authentication | Channels (+ sites) inside one store; account-level tokens across stores. https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/storefront/multi-storefront | Yes, rich topic list; **no payload signature** (custom headers); retries ~48 h then deactivated. https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/integrations/webhooks | Admin, Storefront, Account GraphQL exist. https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/start/about | Partner Portal sandbox stores. https://docs.bigcommerce.com/docs/start/about/sandboxes |
| Magento OS / Adobe Commerce | OAuth 1.0a exists but is **merchant-initiated from the admin** ("Activate"); no PIM-side redirect. https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/get-started/authentication/gs-authentication-oauth | Integration tokens (long-lived) or admin bearer (4 h). https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/get-started/authentication/gs-authentication-token | websites → stores → store views; `/rest/{store_code}/V1`; MSI stocks per website. https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/get-started/gs-web-api-request | **None native in Open Source**; Adobe Commerce: I/O Events + sync Webhooks (Adobe Commerce ≥2.4.4). https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/extensibility/events/installation/ | Yes, storefront-oriented `/graphql`. https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/ | None hosted; self-install + sample data. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/commerce-operations/installation-guide/overview |
| Wix | **Yes** — unlisted app + share install link / app-installer URL, no review; token via client-credentials per instance (4 h). https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/install-your-app/share-an-app-install-link.md | Key-paste alternative: API key + `wix-site-id` (owner/co-owner only). https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/api-keys/about-api-keys.md | One store per site; many sites per account; multi-location inventory in Catalog V3. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-inventory-management.md | Yes; JWT signed with app public key; 12 retries; V1 and V3 catalog events separate. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/api-integrations/events-and-webhooks/about-webhooks.md | Yes (Developer Preview) `POST https://www.wixapis.com/graphql`. https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/work-with-wix-apis/platform/about-the-wix-graph-ql-api.md | Free dev site from app dashboard. https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/launch-your-app/app-distribution/test-your-app/test-your-app-on-a-premium-site.md |
| Squarespace | OAuth 2.0 exists but client credentials are issued **after Squarespace review** of the registration. https://developers.squarespace.com/oauth | Key-paste: Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys (Commerce Advanced plan). https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/authentication-and-permissions | One site = one store. | Yes but only order/contact/address/extension topics; `Squarespace-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 hex; OAuth-only subscriptions. https://developers.squarespace.com/webhooks/verifying-notifications | No. | None; needs a Commerce Advanced site. |
| PrestaShop | **No** (Basic-auth key; Admin API is client-credentials). https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/oauth/ | Webservice key (Advanced Parameters > Web service) or Admin API client id/secret (Advanced Parameters > Admin API). https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/webservice/tutorials/creating-access/ | Shop groups / shops; `id_shop`/`id_group_shop`; Admin API `shopId…` (experimental). https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/admin-api/multi-shop/ | **None native** (PHP hooks only). https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/modules/concepts/hooks/ | No. | Docker image `prestashop/prestashop`. https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/9/basics/installation/environments/docker/ |
| Shopware 6 | **No redirect OAuth**; the "Allow" is installing an app (manifest permissions) which triggers the signed registration handshake. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/lifecycle/app-registration-setup.html | Integration access key/secret → `/api/oauth/token` client_credentials. https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/settings/system/integrationen | Sales channels (storefront/headless/feed) with per-channel product visibility. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/concepts/commerce/catalog/sales-channels.html | Yes (apps or `webhook` entity); `shopware-shop-signature` HMAC-SHA256 of body with shop secret; async with retries/error count. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/apps/webhook.html | No. | Self-hosted Docker/Dockware. https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/installation/ |

<a id="cx-research-2026-08-29-r8-nango-md"></a>
## 18. SOURCE: `docs/cx-research-2026-08-29/R8-nango.md`

### R8 — How Nango is built (design-pattern study, not a dependency)

Studied 2026-08-29 against `NangoHQ/nango` **branch `master`** (tree fetched via the GitHub API; migrations in the tree run up to 2026-08-18, so this is the current code, not the 2024 layout the brief assumed). Every path below is relative to the repo root and resolves as `https://github.com/NangoHQ/nango/blob/master/<path>`. Anything I could not open is marked **unverified**.

**Licence of every file quoted here: Elastic License 2.0 (ELv2)** — the repo has exactly one `LICENSE` (root) and every `packages/*/package.json` says `"license": "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE FILE IN GIT REPOSITORY"` or omits the field (private packages). Excerpts are ≤10 lines each and are quoted for study only. **The intent is re-implementation of the patterns in our own code, not copying Nango code.**

Local copies of the files I read are in `scratchpad/nango/src/…` (same relative paths) and `scratchpad/nango/providers.yaml`.

---

#### 1. Licence

| Where | What | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `LICENSE` (root) | **Elastic License 2.0**. Grants copy/modify/derivative works; forbids providing the software as a hosted/managed service and circumventing licence keys. | `LICENSE` lines 1–12 |
| `LICENSE_SHORT` | `Copyright (c) 2023 Nango Inc, all rights reserved.` | `LICENSE_SHORT` |
| `README.md` §License | "Nango is available under the Elastic License … You can also self-host for free with a limited feature set." | `README.md` line 131 |
| `packages/*/package.json` (all 41) | `license` = `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE FILE IN GIT REPOSITORY` (cli, frontend, node-client, shared, types, providers-adjacent, egress, server, runner, persist, authz, utils, usage, internal-auth, data-ingestion) or **absent** (all other private packages). **No package declares MIT/Apache.** | verified by reading each package.json |
| `packages/**/LICENSE` | **None exist** — searched the full 9,478-blob tree; only root `LICENSE` and `LICENSE_SHORT`. | tree scan |
| `NangoHQ/integration-templates` (separate repo, the sync/action scripts) | Also **ELv2** (`LICENSE` line 1 "Elastic License 2.0 (ELv2)"; GitHub reports `NOASSERTION`). | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NangoHQ/integration-templates/main/LICENSE` |
| `docs/guides/platform/self-hosting.mdx` | Self-hosting is positioned as **Enterprise plan only** ("An Enterprise plan subscription is required"); the "free self-host, limited feature set" of the README is not enumerated anywhere I could read — **unverified** which features are gated. | `docs/guides/platform/self-hosting.mdx` |

**So the premise "which directories are MIT vs ELv2" has an empty answer: the whole monorepo, including the published npm packages `@nangohq/node`, `@nangohq/frontend`, `nango` (CLI), `@nangohq/types`, `@nangohq/providers`, `@nangohq/runner-sdk`, `@nangohq/nango-yaml`, is ELv2.** ELv2 does not forbid reading or re-implementing; it forbids reselling Nango as a service. We are re-implementing.

---

#### 2. The providers catalogue — `packages/providers/providers.yaml`

27,434 lines, 982 entries (`display_name` count). Schema lives in **`packages/types/lib/providers/provider.ts`** (`BaseProvider` + per-auth-mode interfaces); auth-mode enum in `packages/types/lib/auth/api.ts`.

##### auth_mode values (counted in the YAML)
`API_KEY` 323 · `OAUTH2` 294 · `OAUTH2_CC` 101 · `BASIC` 97 · `TWO_STEP` 62 · `MCP_OAUTH2` 24 · `OAUTH1` 4 · `JWT` 4 · `NONE` 2 · `MCP_OAUTH2_GENERIC` 2 · `BILL` 2 · `TBA` 1 · `SIGNATURE` 1 · `INSTALL_PLUGIN` 1 · `CUSTOM` 1 · `AWS_SIGV4` 1 · `APP` 1. (`TABLEAU` and `APP_STORE` from the brief no longer exist as modes.)

##### Field vocabulary (from `provider.ts`, with YAML usage counts)
- Identity/docs: `display_name`, `categories`, `docs`, `docs_connect`, `setup_guide_url`, `alias` (67 — entry inherits another).
- OAuth2: `authorization_url`, `token_url` (string or per-mode object `{OAUTH2, APP}`), `authorization_params` (244), `token_params` (374), `refresh_params` (211), `refresh_url` (16), `scope_separator` (104), `default_scopes` (55), `disable_pkce` (72), `authorization_method: header|body` (16; simple-oauth2 `authorizationMethod`), `body_format: form|json|query` (87), `token_request_auth_method: basic|custom|private_key_jwt` (76), `token_expiration_buffer` (**2 uses**, seconds), `expires_in_unit: milliseconds`, `alternate_access_token_response_path`, `authorization_code_param_in_callback` (3 — e.g. SP-API `spapi_oauth_code`), `authorization_url_replacements` (7 — rename `client_id=`→`clientId=`), `authorization_url_skip_encode`, `authorization_url_skip_empty`, `authorization_url_fragment`, `token_url_skip_encode`.
- Metadata capture: `redirect_uri_metadata` (12 — copy named callback query params into `connection_config`), `token_response_metadata` (25 — copy fields of the token JSON into `connection_config`), `webhook_response_metadata`, `refresh_token_response_metadata`.
- End-user inputs: `connection_config: Record<string, SimplifiedJSONSchema>` (408) and `credentials` (527) — each field `{type:'string', title, description, example, pattern, format, order, default_value, hidden, prefix, suffix, doc_section, secret, automated, enum, warnings, visible_when}`; `integration_config` (per integration, not per connection).
- Proxy: `proxy.base_url` (with `${…}` interpolation and a `A || B` fallback), `proxy.headers`, `proxy.query`, `proxy.body`, `proxy.retry: {at, after, remaining, error_code[], in_body{path,value,strategy}}` (161 retry blocks: 102 `after`, 56 `at`, 5 `error_code`, 4 `remaining`, 1 `in_body`), `proxy.paginate` (cursor/link/offset), `proxy.decompress`, `proxy.forward_headers_on_redirect`, `proxy.verification: {method, endpoints[], base_url_override, headers, data}`.
- Hooks: `webhook_routing_script` (54), `webhook_user_defined_secret` (20), `webhook_allowed_query_params`, `post_connection_script` (41), `pre_connection_deletion_script` (4), `credentials_verification_script` (12).
- TWO_STEP/JWT/SIGNATURE: `token_response: {token, token_expiration, token_expiration_strategy: expireAt|expireIn, refresh_token}`, `token_headers`, `token_request_method`, `additional_steps[]`, `assertion`, `signature: {protocol}`, `token: {signing_key, expires_in_ms, header, payload}`.

Interpolation tokens seen: `${connectionConfig.x}`, `${credentials.x}`, `${accessToken}`, `${clientId}`, `${clientSecret}`, `${random}` (Walmart nonce), `${base64(${credentials.username}:${credentials.password})}`.

Retry-header examples (short excerpts):
```yaml
# exact-online (providers.yaml ~7943)
retry:
    at: ['x-ratelimit-minutely-reset', 'x-ratelimit-reset']
    error_code: ['429', '503']
# github (~9351): at: ['x-ratelimit-reset'], remaining: 'x-ratelimit-remaining', error_code: ['403','5xx','401','429']
# google (~9826): in_body: { path: error.message, value: /User-rate limit exceeded\. +Retry after (.+)/, strategy: at }
```

##### Commerce entries, verbatim-ish (all ELv2, `packages/providers/providers.yaml`, line numbers given)

**shopify** (21544–21572)
```yaml
shopify:
    display_name: Shopify (OAuth)
    auth_mode: OAUTH2
    authorization_url: https://${connectionConfig.subdomain}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize
    token_url: https://${connectionConfig.subdomain}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token
    proxy: { base_url: https://${connectionConfig.subdomain}.myshopify.com, headers: { x-shopify-access-token: ${accessToken} } }
    webhook_routing_script: shopifyWebhookRouting
    token_params: { expiring: 1 }
    connection_config: { subdomain: { type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]+$', prefix: https://, suffix: .myshopify.com } }
```
Notes: `expiring: 1` asks Shopify for expiring tokens (refresh flow). No `retry` block. No scopes in the entry (scopes live on the integration record `oauth_scopes`).

**ebay** (7479–7496) and **ebay-sandbox** (7497–7514)
```yaml
ebay:
    auth_mode: OAUTH2
    authorization_url: https://auth.ebay.com/oauth2/authorize
    token_url: https://api.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token
    authorization_params: { response_type: code }
    token_params: { grant_type: authorization_code }
    refresh_params: { grant_type: refresh_token }
    token_request_auth_method: basic
    proxy: { base_url: https://api.ebay.com/ }
```
Missing: no `retry`, no `scope_separator` (eBay wants space — default is space), no modelling of eBay's **refresh-token expiry (18 months)** — Nango has no `refresh_token_expires_at` at all; no RuName/`redirect_uri` metadata; no marketplace/site id in `connection_config`.

**amazon** (1254–1279) — plain Login-with-Amazon: `authorization_url: https://www.amazon.com/ap/oa`, `token_url: https://api.amazon.${connectionConfig.extension}/auth/o2/token`, `proxy.base_url: https://api.amazon.com`, `connection_config.extension` (`com`, `co.uk`…).

**amazon-selling-partner** (1280–1343) — the SP-API entry:
```yaml
amazon-selling-partner:
    auth_mode: OAUTH2
    authorization_url: https://${connectionConfig.domain}/apps/authorize/consent
    token_url: https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token
    authorization_code_param_in_callback: spapi_oauth_code
    disable_pkce: true
    authorization_params: { application_id: ${connectionConfig.applicationId} }
    refresh_params: { grant_type: refresh_token }
    redirect_uri_metadata: [selling_partner_id]
    proxy:
        base_url: https://${connectionConfig.subdomain}-${connectionConfig.region}.amazon.com || https://sellingpartnerapi-${connectionConfig.region}.amazon.com
        headers: { x-amz-access-token: ${accessToken} }
```
`connection_config`: `applicationId` (pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+$`), `domain` (pattern `^[a-z0-9.-]+\.amazon\.[a-z.]+$`, e.g. `sellercentral.amazon.com`), `subdomain` enum `sellingpartnerapi|sandbox.sellingpartnerapi`, `region` enum `na|eu|fe`. **amazon-selling-partner-beta** (1344–1399) is the same with `version: beta` in `authorization_params` and a sandbox base_url. Missing: `state`-based `version=beta` toggling on one entry; no Restricted-Data-Token (RDT) support; no `retry` block (SP-API returns `x-amzn-RateLimit-Limit`, not a reset header, so Nango would fall back to exponential backoff); marketplace IDs are not modelled.

**etsy** (7887–7906): OAUTH2, `authorization_url: https://www.etsy.com/oauth/connect`, `token_url: https://api.etsy.com/v3/public/oauth/token`, `refresh_params grant_type refresh_token`, `proxy.base_url https://api.etsy.com`, `proxy.headers.x-api-key: ${clientId}:${clientSecret}` (Etsy wants the keystring; note the header template needs the integration's client id, which is why `ProxyRequest` fetches integration config when a header mentions `${clientId}`). PKCE on (default) — Etsy requires it.

**bigcommerce** (3410–3444): OAUTH2, `authorization_url https://login.bigcommerce.com/oauth2/authorize`, `token_url https://login.bigcommerce.com/oauth2/token`, `scope_separator ' '`, `authorization_params: {response_type: code, context: stores/${connectionConfig.storeHash}, account_uuid: ${connectionConfig.accountUuid}}`, `token_params.context: stores/${connectionConfig.storeHash}`, `proxy.base_url https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/${connectionConfig.storeHash}`, header `x-auth-token: ${accessToken}`; `connection_config.storeHash` (pattern alnum), `accountUuid` (`automated: true`). Note: BigCommerce tokens don't expire → no `refresh_params`; Nango will store `expires_at` = now+1 day by default (`DEFAULT_EXPIRES_AT_MS`) and simply never refresh (`expired_oauth2_no_refresh_token`).

**walmart** (25687–25718):
```yaml
walmart:
    auth_mode: OAUTH2
    authorization_url: https://login.account.wal-mart.com/authorize
    authorization_params: { clientType: ${connectionConfig.clientType}, nonce: ${random} }
    disable_pkce: true
    authorization_url_replacements: { 'response_type=': 'responseType=', 'client_id=': 'clientId=', 'redirect_uri=': 'redirectUri=' }
    token_url: https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token
    redirect_uri_metadata: [sellerId]
    proxy: { base_url: https://marketplace.walmartapis.com, headers: { wm_qos.correlation_id: ${random}, wm_sec.access_token: ${accessToken} } }
```
`connection_config.clientType` hidden with `default_value: seller`. Shows the "string-replace the OAuth param names" escape hatch.

**woocommerce** (25989–26023): `auth_mode: BASIC` (consumer key/secret as username/password), `proxy.base_url https://${connectionConfig.storeURL}`, and a **verification** block: `proxy.verification: {method: GET, headers: {content-type: application/json}, endpoints: [/wp-json/wc/v3/customers]}`.

**shopware** (21803–21838): `OAUTH2_CC`, `body_format: json`, `token_url https://${connectionConfig.shopwareUrl}/api/oauth/token`, `credentials.client_id/client_secret` (`secret: true`), `connection_config.shopwareUrl` (`format: hostname`). **squarespace** (22345): OAUTH2, `token_request_auth_method: basic`, `scope_separator ','`, user-agent header from connection_config. **tiktok-accounts / tiktok-ads** (23633/23654): OAuth2 with `refresh_url` and `authorization_url_replacements: {client_id: client_key}` / `{client_id: app_id}`.

**Absent from the catalogue** (grepped, zero hits): `tiktok-shop`, `zalando`, `bol`/`bol.com`, `allegro`, `google-merchant` / Content API / `merchant-center`, `kaufland`, `otto`, `mirakl`, `cdiscount`. Also absent: any commerce entry with a `retry` block — none of shopify/ebay/amazon/etsy/bigcommerce/walmart declare rate-limit headers, so all of them fall back to generic backoff.

#### 3. Connections and credentials

**Table** `_nango_connections` (`packages/database/lib/migrations/20221026075018_create_connection.cjs` + later): `provider_config_key`, `connection_id` (unique together), `credentials` JSON, `connection_config` JSON, `metadata` JSON, `credentials_iv`, `credentials_tag` (`20230322233042_add_encryption_to_connection.cjs`), `last_fetched_at` (`20230724110746`), and — the health columns from `20250310134848_connection_add_meta_fields.cjs`:
```sql
ADD COLUMN "credentials_expires_at" timestamptz,
ADD COLUMN "last_refresh_success" timestamptz,
ADD COLUMN "last_refresh_failure" timestamptz,
ADD COLUMN "refresh_attempts" int2,
ADD COLUMN "refresh_exhausted" bool
```
plus `last_execution_at` (`20250626163600`), `end_user_id`, `tags`, `webhook_url_override`, `config_id`. TS type: `packages/types/lib/connection/db.ts` (`DBConnection`; `credentials: { encrypted_credentials?: string }`).

**Encryption** — `packages/utils/lib/encryption.ts` class `Encryption`: **AES-256-GCM**, 12-byte random IV, base64 encoding, 16-byte auth tag, key must be base64 256-bit (`encryptSync` returns `[ciphertext, iv, authTag]`). `packages/shared/lib/utils/encryption.manager.ts` `encryptConnection` stores `credentials: {encrypted_credentials}` + `credentials_iv` + `credentials_tag`; `decryptConnection` reverses; the same manager encrypts `oauth_client_secret` on integrations and env variables. PBKDF2-SHA256 with 310,000 iterations is used to hash the encryption key / session tokens (`PBKDF2_ITERATIONS`, `KEY_HASH_ITERATIONS`). Enterprise adds envelope encryption of the DEK with AWS KMS (`packages/kms/lib/envelope.ts`, `@aws-crypto/client-node`, `REQUIRE_ENCRYPT_REQUIRE_DECRYPT`, DEK 32 bytes, encryption-context assertion). Records can be encrypted per row too (`packages/records/lib/utils/encryption.ts`, not read in detail).

**Credential parsing** — `connection.service.ts` `parseRawCredentials` (line 1462): for OAUTH2, `expires_at` = provided `expires_at` or `now + expires_in*1000`; keeps `refresh_token` and the whole `raw` token response; supports `alternate_access_token_response_path`.

**Refresh — `packages/shared/lib/services/connections/credentials/refresh.ts`** (677 lines). Entry `refreshOrTestCredentials(props)`:
1. `updateLastFetched` — `UPDATE … WHERE id IN (SELECT id … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)` so concurrent readers don't queue on the row (`connection.service.ts` 1447).
2. Short-circuits (unless `instantRefresh`): `refresh_exhausted` → `connection_refresh_exhausted`; `last_refresh_failure` within **30 s** (`REFRESH_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS`) → `connection_refresh_backoff`.
3. Dispatch on `credentials.type`: `OAUTH2|APP|OAUTH2_CC|JWT|BILL|TWO_STEP|SIGNATURE|AWS_SIGV4` → `refreshCredentials`; `BASIC|API_KEY|TBA` → `testCredentials` (runs the provider `verification` endpoint / script); `CUSTOM|OAUTH1` → nothing.
4. On error: `setRefreshFailure` (`connection.service.ts` 857):
```ts
// Only increment once per day to avoid burst failed refresh invalidating a connection (e.g: provider being down)
if (lastRefreshFailure && (… lastRefreshFailure.getDate() < now.getDate())) { attempt += 1; }
… refresh_attempts: attempt, refresh_exhausted: attempt >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DAYS_FAILED_REFRESH
```
with `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DAYS_FAILED_REFRESH = 4` (`connections/utils.ts`). `markConnectionAuthFailed` sets exhausted immediately (used when the provider says the grant is revoked). **`refresh_exhausted` semantics: four distinct calendar days of failed refresh → stop trying automatically; only a manual `instantRefresh` (dashboard / API `force_refresh`) bypasses it, and a successful refresh resets `refresh_attempts=null, refresh_exhausted=false`.** `getStaleConnections` (line 986) selects `refresh_exhausted false AND last_fetched_at < now - N days` for a proactive refresh cron (cron itself unverified).

**The refresh lock** — `refreshCredentialsIfNeeded` (line 366):
- process-local **in-flight promise map** keyed `${env}:${providerConfigKey}:${connectionId}` (`FixedSizeMap(5000)`) collapses concurrent callers in one process;
- then a **Redis lock** `lock:refresh:${env}:${providerConfigKey}:${connectionId}`, TTL 10 s, acquisition timeout 12 s, via `packages/kvstore/lib/Locking.ts` (`store.set(key,'1',{canOverride:false, ttlMs})` = SET NX PX, polled every 50 ms). Their own comment: "This is not a distributed lock and will not work in a multi-redis environment. It could also be unsafe in case of a Redis crash."
- **double-checked**: after acquiring, re-read the connection and re-evaluate `shouldRefreshCredentials`; if another worker already refreshed, return the fresh creds without refreshing. If lock acquisition **times out**, re-read once more; if fresh, return it; else fail.
- `shouldRefreshCredentials`: buffer = `provider.token_expiration_buffer || 15 min` (`REFRESH_MARGIN_MS`); `isTokenExpired(expires_at, buffer)`; no `expires_at` → never refresh; expired OAUTH2 without `refresh_token` → `{should:false, reason:'expired_oauth2_no_refresh_token'}` (except providers that re-auth with client credentials); some providers use token introspection instead of `expires_at`; facebook/instagram/threads only refresh on demand.
- success path: `updateConnection({ …, credentials_expires_at: getExpiresAtFromCredentials(newCredentials), last_refresh_success: now, last_refresh_failure: null, refresh_attempts: null, refresh_exhausted: false })`. `getExpiresAtFromCredentials` defaults: 1 day (`DEFAULT_EXPIRES_AT_MS`) when no expiry, 55 min for OAUTH2_CC, 99 years for OAUTH1.

**Refresh-token rotation** — `packages/shared/lib/clients/oauth2.client.ts` `getFreshOAuth2Credentials` (simple-oauth2 `AccessToken.refresh(refresh_params)`; basic auth header if `token_request_auth_method: basic`; per-connection `config_override` client id/secret honoured):
```ts
newCredentials = connectionsManager.parseRawCredentials(rawNewAccessToken.token, 'OAUTH2', provider) as OAuth2Credentials;
if (!newCredentials.refresh_token && credentials.refresh_token != null) {
    newCredentials.refresh_token = credentials.refresh_token;
}
```
i.e. a rotated refresh token replaces the old one; an omitted one is carried forward. There is **no** tracking of refresh-token expiry (eBay/Amazon LWA 18-month/1-year limits are invisible until a refresh fails).

**Refresh failed → connection marked error** — `packages/server/lib/hooks/hooks.ts` `connectionRefreshFailed` (line 316): creates an **active auth error record** (`errorNotificationService.auth.create({type:'auth', action, connection_id, log_id, active:true})`), sends the customer an `auth` webhook `{operation:'refresh', success:false, error}` signed with the env webhook key, posts to Slack. `connectionRefreshSuccess` (253) clears the active error and, *only if one was cleared*, sends a recovery webhook `{operation:'refresh', success:true}`. Proxy/sync callers get `NangoError('connection_refresh_exhausted')` etc. and the dashboard shows the connection as errored.

**Credentials verification on connect** — `hooks.ts` `testConnectionCredentials` (89): if `provider.credentials_verification_script` → run the named handler (`server/lib/hooks/connection/providers/<p>/credentials-verification.ts`, 12 providers); else if `provider.proxy.verification` → `credentialsTest` (387) loops `endpoints`, builds an `ApplicationConstructedProxyConfiguration` and fires a `ProxyRequest`; any 2xx = `Ok({tested:true})`, else `connection_test_failed`. The same function is reused as the periodic "test" for API_KEY/BASIC connections (so `last_refresh_success` is meaningful for non-OAuth too).

---

#### 4. OAuth flow — `packages/server/lib/controllers/oauth.controller.ts` (2,737 lines)

**Authorize request** `oauthRequest` (line 101): reads `provider_config_key`, `connection_id` (generated if absent), `ws_client_id`, optional `connect_session_token`, optional `hmac`. If `environment.hmac_enabled` and not a connect session, verifies `hmac` = HMAC-SHA256(`hmac_key`, `${providerConfigKey}:${connectionId}`) (`packages/shared/lib/services/hmac.service.ts`; plain `===` compare, not timing-safe). Builds an `OAuthSession`:
```ts
const session: OAuthSession = {
    providerConfigKey, provider: config.provider, connectionId, callbackUrl,
    authMode: provider.auth_mode,
    codeVerifier: crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex'),
    id: uuid.v1(),
    connectSessionId: connectSession ? connectSession.id : null,
    connectionConfig, webhookUrlOverride: …, environmentId, webSocketClientId: wsClientId, activityLogId: logCtx.id, …
```
**State storage**: the session row is inserted into **`_nango_oauth_sessions`** (`packages/server/lib/services/oauth-session.service.ts`; table from `packages/database/lib/migrations/20230326083713_create_oauth_session.cjs` with columns `id uuid, provider_config_key, provider, connection_id, callback_url, auth_mode, account_id, connection_config json, web_socket_client_id, code_verifier, request_token_secret, timestamps`). **`state` = `session.id`** (a v1 UUID). Orphan sessions are swept by `deleteExpiredSessions({olderThan})`.

**PKCE** (line 711): "We always implement PKCE, no matter whether the server requires it or not, unless it has been explicitly turned off for this template" — `code_challenge = base64url(sha256(codeVerifier))`, `code_challenge_method=S256`; the verifier never leaves the server (it's in the session row) and is sent as `code_verifier` in the token exchange (line 1745).

**CSRF double-submit cookie** (line 804): `res.cookie('oauth2-${session.id}', '1', {maxAge: 1h, httpOnly, secure, sameSite: secure ? 'none' : 'lax'})`. In the callback (1291–1345) the cookie's presence is **measured** (metrics with `sec-fetch-*` tags) and only **rejected when the feature flag `isOAuthStateCookieEnforced` is on** — a rollout in progress.

**Authorization URL**: simple-oauth2 `authorizeURL({redirect_uri: callbackUrl, scope, state: session.id, …allAuthParams})` where `allAuthParams` = interpolated `authorization_params` + PKCE + per-request overrides; then the template hacks `authorization_url_skip_encode`, `authorization_url_fragment`, `authorization_url_replacements` (string replace), `authorization_url_skip_empty`. Scopes come from the integration's `oauth_scopes` (comma-joined) re-joined with `scope_separator`. `callback_url` = `environment.callback_url` (per-environment override, default `<server>/oauth/callback`).

**Callback** `oauthCallback` (1222): `state = req.query.state || payload || customField`; `findById(state)`; **session deleted immediately (single use)**; then by `authMode` → `oauth2Callback` (1487): code param = `provider.authorization_code_param_in_callback || 'code'`; `callbackMetadata` = the query params named in `redirect_uri_metadata` (`getConnectionMetadataFromCallbackRequest`, `server/lib/utils/utils.ts` 103); missing code → `WSErrBuilder.InvalidCallbackOAuth2(providerContext)` where the provider's `error`, `error_description`, `error_reason`, `error_uri`, `status_code`, `error_message` query params are folded into the message (`web-socket-error.ts`). `handleTokenExchangeAndConnectionCreation` (1694): interpolates `token_params`, adds `code_verifier`, basic auth header if configured, `assertSafeOAuthUrl` (egress policy), token exchange via simple-oauth2 or a provider-specific client (`provider.client.ts`, for the odd ones), `getConnectionMetadata(raw, provider, 'token_response_metadata')`, `parseRawCredentials`, then `connection_config = {...tokenMetadata, ...callbackMetadata, ...webhookMetadata, ...sessionConfig}`, upsert, `post_connection_script`, `validateConnection` hook, audit.

**Result delivery to the popup/opener** — two channels:
1. **WebSocket + Redis**: `packages/server/lib/clients/publisher.client.ts` — the browser SDK opens a WS first; server replies `{message_type:'connection_ack', ws_client_id}`; the popup URL carries `ws_client_id`; on completion the server sends `{message_type:'success'|'error', …}` to that WS; if this server instance doesn't hold the socket it publishes on Redis channel `publisher:<wsClientId>` and the instance that does forwards it ("multiple instances of the server running in parallel").
2. **postMessage from the callback page** (`packages/server/lib/utils/html.ts`, 138–195): the rendered page posts `{type:'nango_oauth_callback_success'}` or `{type:'nango_oauth_callback_error', payload:{message, errorType}}` to `window.opener` (`'*'`) **and** on a `BroadcastChannel('nango-oauth-callback')` (COOP fallback); it waits for `{type:'nango_oauth_callback_ack'}` from the Connect UI before `window.close()`, else self-closes after 500 ms on success; on error it stays open showing a "Show error details" toggle.

**Browser SDK** `packages/frontend/lib/index.ts` + `authModal.ts`: `Nango.auth(providerConfigKey, connectionId?, options)` → `AuthorizationModal` opens `new WebSocket(webSocketUrl)`, on ack sets `ws_client_id` and `window.open` with a centred popup (`computeLayout`); polls `modal.closed` to raise `AuthError('windowClosed')`; `AuthError` types include `blocked_by_browser`, `windowClosed`, `invalid_credentials`, `resource_capped`. Query string gets `connect_session_token=` or `hmac=`.

**Connect UI** (`packages/connect-ui`, iframe) ↔ host page (`packages/frontend/lib/connectUI.ts`): iframe→parent events `{type:'ready'}`, `{type:'close'}`, `{type:'connect', payload: AuthResult}`, `{type:'error', payload:{errorType, errorMessage}}` (`connect-ui/src/lib/events.ts`); parent→iframe `{type:'session_token', sessionToken}`; the parent **checks `event.origin` against the Connect UI base URL** (connectUI.ts 137). The iframe's `Go.tsx` listens for the popup's `nango_oauth_callback_*` messages and ACKs them.

**Connect session token** (`packages/server/lib/controllers/connect/postSessions.ts`, `services/connectSession.service.ts`, `packages/keystore/lib/models/privatekeys.ts`): `POST /connect/sessions {end_user, organization, allowed_integrations, integrations_config_defaults{user_scopes, authorization_params, connection_config{oauth_scopes_override,…}}, overrides, webhook_url_override, tags}`; the token is `nango_connect_session_<random>`, stored as **PBKDF2 hash** (`hashValue`) + AES-GCM encrypted copy, `expires_at = now + 30 min` (`CONNECT_SESSION_TTL_MS`); lookup `WHERE hash = ? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now)`. `postReconnect` re-issues a session bound to an existing connection.

**OAuth1** (`server/lib/clients/oauth1.client.ts`): request token → store `request_token_secret` in the same session row → callback with `oauth_verifier` → access token (state is carried manually because OAuth1 doesn't echo it).
